latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Video Editor for YouTube.
- Upload raw video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe the edits you want.
- Automatic editing features: cut dead air, add transitions, and export in YouTube-ready MP4 format within 1-2 minutes.
- No need for complex software—simple text instructions handle editing, export, and credit checking.
- Anonymous free tier available with sign-up for 100 credits (7-day expiry).
- Full support for session management, export queueing, supported formats, and comprehensive error handling.
